# External Dependencies

Third-party libraries used by the embedded platform are kept in this directory.

Examples:

- GoogleTest
- FreeRTOS
- Other approved third-party libraries

Each dependency should have a documented version and source.

## STM32CubeF1

STM32F1 device headers, CMSIS components and STM32 HAL
are provided by STMicroelectronics' STM32CubeF1 package.

The dependency remains under its own upstream licensing terms.
